name: Davco Rejuvenation Grout
paste:
DAVCO REJUVENATION GROUT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco Rejuvenation Grout, August 2022, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/davco-rejuvenationgrout.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco Rejuvenation Grout where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2022, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - Davco Rejuvenation Grout is a premixed, ready to use grout designed to be applied straight over existing grout.
    - Davco Rejuvenation Grout suitable for grout joints 1- 5mm wide and a maximum 5mm depth.
    - Davco Rejuvenation Grout is fast and easy to use and is stain, mould and bacteria resistant.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Suitable for glossy and smooth tiles only. Grout joints with at least 1mm of depth from the existing grout surface to the top of the tile.
    - Note: Do not use on flush joints or highly textured and / or porous / unglazed tiles.
    - Areas Suitable for interior and exterior applications. Commercial and domestic walls and floors including pools and submerged areas.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.8.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco Rejuvenation Grout
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2022, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - SCAQMD method 304-91: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Volatile organic compound (VOC) content (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Ready to use
    - Suitable for use in pools
    - Easy and fast application
    - Stain, mould and bacteria resistant
    - No need to rake out full depth of existing grout - only needs 1mm depth
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance / Colour: Coloured paste
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: Low VOC - 2g/L (SCAQMD method 304-91)
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 1.7kg pails
    - Shelf life: 12 Months from date of manufacture if unopened
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions, off ground out of direct sunlight

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2022, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation.
    - All surfaces must be installed according to manufacturer’s instructions and relevant Australian Standard(s) and be structurally sound, dry, clean and free from movement, oil, grease, wax, sealers, curing compounds, release agents and any other loose or contaminating material
    - The tile and grout surface must be thoroughly cleaned with either a mild soap and water mixture or sugar soap mixture. If required, a bristle brush can be used to clean the existing grout joints
    - Rinse surface with clean water to ensure there is no residue on the surface and allow the surface to completely dry prior to application of Rejuvenation Grout

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2022, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: 1.7kg pail of Davco Rejuvenation Grout covers approximately 20m2 (based on 200 x 200mm tiles with a 4mm wide by 1mm deep grout joint)
4.3 Applied Product Ready for Use.
    | Application | Wait time |
    | Dry Areas | 12 hours |
    | Wet Areas | 2 days |
    | Submerged Areas | 7 days |
    All measurements are taken at 22ºC and 50% relative humidity. Specifications vary according to site conditions and should be taken as a guide only.
4.4 Equipment.
    - Protective personal equipment
    - Grout float or squeegee
    - Grouting sponge
    - Bucket and clean water
4.5 Mixing. Stir thoroughly before use
4.6 Application. 1. Apply to the grout joint and using the float or squeegee, spread diagonally across the joint. Ensure you are filling the joint evenly. Only cover 1m² at a time as Rejuvenation Grout will be difficult to clean off once it dries. 2. After approximately 5-10 minutes, clean off excess grout and evenly shape the grout joints by laying a damp sponge on the tile surface and lightly wiping in a circular motion. 3. Finish the application with a single diagonal wipe to the tile surface with a well wrung sponge. Avoid applying excessive force or repeatedly wiping as this may remove the grout from the joint. If the water in the bucket becomes dirty, replace with clean water.
4.7 Cleaning of tools. Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water prior to the grout drying.
4.8 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test the grout in an inconspicuous area first
    - Do not apply in temperatures above 35ºC or below 5ºC
    - In cool and / or humid conditions, allow longer setting times
    - Davco Rejuvenation Grout is not recommended for use on highly textured or porous tiles due to its high bond strength
    - Existing grout must be at least 1mm below the surface of the tile, allowing sufficient depth for the Rejuvenation Grout to bond to the grout joint
    - Alternatively rake out sufficient grout to allow 1mm depth
    - Do not allow the Rejuvenation Grout to skin / dry out in the tub. Always replace the plastic film after use
    - Do not use acidic cleaners on Rejuvenation Grout
    - When used in pools the pH of the water must remain between 6 and 8
    - For other uses not mentioned in these instructions, please contact Sika Australia

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.8):
    - Do not apply in temperatures above 35ºC or below 5ºC
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Test the grout in an inconspicuous area first
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco Rejuvenation Grout, August 2022, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/davco-rejuvenationgrout.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Rejuvenation Grout - All Colours, version 29/07/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/Rejuvenation%20Grout%20-%20All%20Colours.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Davco Rejuvenation Grout, version 15/07/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/sds-davco-rejuvenationgrout.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Various Semi-Finished, version 15/07/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sds-various-semi-finished.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
